jobs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create an ORIGINAL new UI art direction proposal for the contemporary Chinese zombie survival game 适者生存. Reference images are STYLE AND MATERIAL REFERENCES only, not exact layouts or rules. Retain heavy jagged black ink contours, large charcoal shadow masses, hard square pixel clusters, stair-step silhouettes, restrained 2x2 dithering and bone-white hard highlights. Palette: charcoal #111210, bone #E9DBBC, tarnished brass #89704B, rust #8C4933, dirty olive #74734E, dry blood #8F302A; sparing water teal #6F9A9B and fire amber #D89B48. Modern Chinese ruins, concrete, repaired canvas and salvaged iron. Premium hand-inked pixel game, not soft painting with a noise overlay. Build a fresh, cleaner, production-minded design with consistent slim battered iron frames, quiet opaque dark text fields, large complete object silhouettes and clear Chinese type. No medieval armor, no skull ornament overload, no glossy rounded web dashboard. Dynamic text remains graphically crisp, never scratched through. All numbers depict one illustrative state, not new gameplay rules. One full-bleed single 16:9 desktop mockup, no surrounding desktop monitor, no collage of screens, no watermark.
Asset: newly redesigned survival home screen at 1920x1080. Use Image 1 for atmosphere, Image 2 for iron construction, Image 3 for inked pixel objects. CORRECT the old mockup's excessive decoration and mismatched rows. A thin top game header, left survival rail, central FOUR EXACTLY EQUAL HEIGHT horizontal rows, right read-only object inspector. The four central rows occupy the same vertical interval and have identical height: 场景, 设施, 地面, 随身. Their boundaries must be visibly aligned across the center; no oversized scenic row. Left rail shows 第3日 16:10 and six clean labeled meters: 健康 18.40/20.00, 饱食 62/100, 水分 58/100, 体力 15.60/20.00, 清醒 76/100, 精神 64/100. Small protagonist portrait below, restrained art. Top navigation text: 地图 制作 编队 整备 成长 任务 日志 菜单. First central row: wide ruined forest-camp scene about 60 percent of row width, with a decrepit Chinese bus and shelter, next to two framed adjacent-location cards 林间小径 and 废弃公路. Second row: fire facility, tarp shelter and one resource card. Selected fire is a COMPOSITE card with a readable fire picture at left and EXACTLY TWO small vertically stacked processing slots at right: a pot with water and a single piece of meat. Fuel, progress and short actions remain INSIDE this facility's allocated row and card, never expanding row height. Use local buttons 投入木材 and 等待烹饪 beneath its art. Third row: five normal ground item cards 木材, 净水, 纤维, 生肉, 石块; tall art approximately 70 percent and quiet bone-paper name bands. Fourth row: EXACTLY FIVE root inventory cards 净水, 绷带, 罐头, 打火机, 木材; show 随身 5/5 in row label, no sixth card or add-slot. Right inspector has title 火堆, a large fire illustration and quiet text readouts 燃料 90分钟 and 加工中, with NO distant primary action button; actions are local to fire. Thin footer 行动记录. Charcoal and bone dominant, gold only selected frame, red reserved for warnings. Chunky pixel brushwork closely matching references but sharper typography and less brass clutter. This is a polished new design, not a pasted edit of the old board.

Asset: freshly redesigned fullscreen FOUR-versus-FOUR tactical battle at an abandoned modern Chinese checkpoint. Image 1 supplies only art style and mood; CORRECT its old UI mechanics. Layout: thin header and turn-order portrait rail; left 81 percent is battle scene above action console, right 19 percent is a clearly separated inspector above compact combat log. Scene is about 58 percent of total height; controls about 28 percent, remaining header/queue/footer. EXACTLY FOUR living survivors on left and FOUR infected on right, all full silhouettes visible with clean health bars and short position labels. Left-to-right actual anchors are 我方4 3 2 1 | 敌方1 2 3 4; middle gap clear. Current actor gold outline, one selected enemy crimson targeting outline, non-actors stay subdued. Header 第2回合, 主角 · 普通激活 · AP 3/3. Side-on brutal inked pixel figures, no new named canon characters, modern axe/spear/medical gear/firearm silhouettes; no fantasy costumes. In bottom-left selected actor portrait and AP; middle two weapon page tabs Ⅰ 简易斧 and Ⅱ 空槽. EXACTLY FIVE skill cards for axe, in ONE row, labeled in order: 劈砍 (1级,2AP), 破甲劈 (3级,2AP), 蓄力 (5级,1AP), 震退 (7级), 破阵 (10级). Current axe level 5. Last two cards visibly gray locked with formal names still readable and condition 需要斧7级 / 需要斧10级; no extra lock cards beside them. Distinct woodcut pixel ability illustrations. Below the five cards, a compact secondary command strip with 防御 调息 后退 撤退 结束行动, all reachable; no invented consumable buttons in the action strip. Include a small clearly READ-ONLY 物资查看 button in the inspector, no eating or transferring. Right selected enemy panel 感染者, short target/intent information, compact expected hit preview without giant formulas. No health values based on 100/42; current game health upper bound 20 for protagonist, use only clear small illustrative health bars if crowded. Preserve visceral silhouettes while keeping target information and all five skill cards fully unobstructed. No camp inventory visible during fullscreen battle.

Categories in order: 物品 / 资源 / 设施 / 岗位人物 / 敌踪 / 相邻地点 / 武器 / 技能. 1 Item: 净水 ×3, dented blue-cap water bottle, art70%, quiet label30%, gold selected edge plus small corner selection marker. 2 Resource: 废料箱 with badge 有限 and clear 已耗尽, desaturated art and diagonal hatch but readable name. 3 Facility: 火堆 as composite wide card, fire illustration left, exactly two stacked processing slots right, visible fuel and cooking progress, local buttons 投入木材 and 等待烹饪, no third slot. 4 Post NPC: 机构当班接续员 portrait with small 代班 badge and 事项 marker, not an original named person's portrait label. 5 Encounter: infected silhouette labeled 敌踪 with danger red corner, no implication of automatic battle. 6 Adjacent location: 林间小径, clear known-route direction arrow and 已发现 label. 7 Weapon: 简易斧, complete silhouette, quality tag and short 耐久 readout on a separate information band, no art clipping. 8 Skill: 震退, large symbolic axe-impact art, gray locked state, readable level 7 and 需要斧7级（当前5级）. Under board, a slim state strip showing six little frame treatments with labels 普通 悬停 焦点 选中 禁用 危险; focus uses a clear bone-white corner line, selected gold, danger crimson plus warning shape, disabled uses lock/hatch and text. edits.main: Edit the supplied survival UI mockup. Preserve its established ink-pixel art, all objects, palette, top navigation, left status rail, right read-only inspector, footer and EXACTLY FIVE inventory cards. Change ONLY geometry of the central four rows so their OUTER RECTANGLE HEIGHTS ARE EXACTLY EQUAL. On this 1672x941 composition, the central area spans roughly x314..1326 and y84..858. Use four outer row rectangles each about186 pixels high, at y84..270, y280..466, y476..662, y672..858, with three10px separators. Row1 场景, row2 设施, row3 地面, row4 随身. Third and fourth rows must NOT become shorter than first/second. Fit each row's existing art and labels within its new identical bounds, retaining complete silhouettes. Fire composite retains pot and meat as exactly two stacked processing slots, with fuel 90分钟 and local 投入木材 / 等待烹饪 buttons; none of these may spill into another row. Normal item name bands stay readable, root inventory remains5/5. Do not enlarge left portrait, change any left numeric readouts, add new cards, add new gameplay, or move actions into right inspector. A precise layout correction to the same polished screenshot, not a new concept or a diagram. No guide lines or measurement annotations in the final image.
edits.cards: Edit this component design board, preserving all eight categories, their compositions, art style, palette, NPC/encounter/location imagery, six bottom frame-state examples, and all unaffected lettering. Correct only the facility component and runtime terminology. In the top-row facility 火堆 sample, replace the two right-hand meter-only blocks with EXACTLY TWO real processing-slot boxes stacked vertically: upper slot shows a metal pot and a short 水 label; lower slot shows one piece of meat and a short 烤制 label. Each slot may have its own thin progress bar. Fuel is a SEPARATE SMALL LINE reading 燃料 90分钟, NOT 18/20. Keep 投入木材 and 等待烹饪 local to that facility card; no third slot. In the bottom-row 简易斧 weapon card, change the quality badge from 良品 to 白 and change durability from28/40 to18/24; leave the axe illustration intact. The four account badges at the very bottom must read exactly 有限 / 每日补充 / 本实例 / 本局一次, correcting any misspelled glyphs. No extra equipment or items, no new panels, no changes to the other card counts. Crisp readable Chinese text. This is a precise correction of a review board, not a redesigned overall composition.
